note: NKK recommended DPDT gold-contact replacement for M2022SS1G01; maintained ON-ON, solder lug. Official terminal map: commons 2/5; ON closes 2-3 and 5-6; other position closes 2-1 and 5-4. Poles switch REG1 only to SW_RUN and PRE_CTRL_3V3; pins 1/4 NC. Control signals only, never B9 or main current; verify ON/OFF panel orientation.
